answer: Tie each agent identity to one physical FIDO2 key and store its public credential in a shared vault that rejects any second registration from the same key, since the private key never leaves the device. A verified agent can then meet others on a common terrace, while the harbor that receives it checks the credential against the vault in seconds. Forging 1,000 identities would require buying 1,000 real keys, about $25,000 at $25 each, plus handling every device by hand.
